create_tokenizer_middle_mapping_from_hf: create a TokenizerMiddleMapping instance from a HuggingFace tokenizer using the from_hf_tokenizer class method
auto_infer_tokenizer_mapping: auto infer and return the correct TokenizerMiddleMapping subclass for a given HuggingFace tokenizer
map_gpt2_token_to_bytes: map a GPT2 token ID to its corresponding bytes using GPT2TokenizerMiddleMapping
map_llama_token_to_bytes: map a LLaMA token ID to bytes with BOS space handling using LLAMA1TokenizerMiddleMapping
map_t5_token_to_bytes: map a T5 token ID to bytes with BOS space handling using T5TokenizerMiddleMapping
